name: Avengers Arena
description: Master perfect parries, counter strikes and confirmed hit chains with four heroes in a twelve-stage rooftop tournament.

name: Iron Flight
description: Thread perfect ring centers, build flight chains and dodge the sky commander’s second-phase spread volleys.

name: Monterra Wilds
description: Explore an expanded island with populated habitats, local and island maps, tactical creature battles, evolution and rival duels.

name: Candy Pop
description: Solve jelly and recipe puzzles with special-candy combinations, goal-aware hints and a one-use rewind for each board.

name: Chikoo & Bunty: Mischief Chase
description: Jump and slide through neighborhood obstacles to build skill chains, multiply laddoo points and race home as either brother.

name: Dragon Keep TD
description: Scout incoming waves, select tower targets and unlock armor-piercing arrows, freezing frost and siege blasts.

name: Ghost Village
description: Switch three ninja guardians, shatter frozen spirits, chain team attacks and evade a spectral guardian’s marked strikes.

name: Iron Citadel
description: Breach a 3D fortress with a recon scanner. Find intel, manage ammunition and earn mission stars for precise, careful play.

name: Pride Lands
description: Guard your pride in a 3D savanna. Track prey, heal your pride, stun rival packs and dodge an alpha’s marked pounce.

name: World Strike
description: Move between cover, time perfect reloads for empowered shots, and evade an armored sentinel’s overdrive volleys.
